author: fourdogslong
name: MD3 Darker
description: The darkest variant of the Material Design 3 inspired theme, dimming the lighttable and darkroom backgrounds for editing in dark surroundings.  Originaly from CritLoren, modified by fourdogslong.
notes: Ships as a zip instead of a single css file: extract it into the themes folder so md3-darker.css and its md3 folder sit side by side. The theme also imports darktable's stock darktable.css, so copy that file from your darktable installation into the same themes folder.
